content.text: {"summary":"Hidden unit 7 is never active anywhere in [-1,1]^3: its largest possible pre-activation is about -0.30. I repurposed it as z7 = ReLU(v+1). On the domain v+1 ≥ 0, so this equals v+1 exactly. Setting its output weight to -0.2 adds -0.2*v - 0.2. Raising b2 by 0.2 cancels the constant, so the network gains exactly -0.2*v with no other change in behavior. The damping estimate is rough. The local slope of the original output with respect to v near the origin is about -0.7 to -0.8, suggesting an original c of roughly 0.8. After the edit that becomes about 1.0, which is the value reported.","estimated_c":1.0,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[7,0],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[7,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W1","index":[7,2],"value":0.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[7],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[7],"value":-0.2},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.00393424}]}
